method: Increase existing anatomically fitted sleeve influence from 0.85 to 0.98 and reduce its stand-off from 12 to 7 mm, matching the existing full-body clearance allowance. Preserve the original geodesic raglan/cuff/shoulder fades, original body keys, old garment controls/fields/keys, bone weights, rig, walk and licensed maps. No physical cloth simulation or full-body collision claim.

body_taper.method: New editable support key, evaluated relative to the retained mixed source body. Thirteen weighted cross sections define each existing forearm centerline. Reduce radial excess toward a mildly elliptical adult forearm profile, capped at 8 mm with elbow/wrist fades. Original controls/keys/UVs/bone weights remain exact; this is authored fitting anatomy, not a measured scan or a visible replacement skin mesh.

shell_correction.method: Original thickness settings retained. Even-offset, thickness-clamp and increased smoothing experiments rejected for new overlap pairs elsewhere in the walk. Existing source shell contacts remain an open cloth issue.
